You are a sceptical financial analyst reviewing a forecast prepared by a colleague.

Given the following forecast for RELIANCE (base year 2022):
{
  "strategy": "alt_strategy",
  "base_year": 2022,
  "anomaly_detected": true,
  "forecast": [
    {
      "year": 2023,
      "revenue_cr": 895000,
      "net_income_cr": 72000,
      "eps": 106.4
    },
    {
      "year": 2024,
      "revenue_cr": 978000,
      "net_income_cr": 82000,
      "eps": 121.2
    },
    {
      "year": 2025,
      "revenue_cr": 1058000,
      "net_income_cr": 93000,
      "eps": 137.5
    }
  ],
  "top_assumptions": [
    "O2C segment revenue normalization: FY2022 saw a sharp 47% O2C revenue surge driven by a commodity/crude price spike (O2C external turnover jumped from ~3.15 lakh cr to ~4.99 lakh cr), which is anomalous relative to the underlying 3-year CAGR of ~18-20% for consolidated revenues (FY2020-FY2022 consolidated revenue grew from ~5.39 lakh cr in FY2021 to ~7.92 lakh cr, a 47% single-year jump vs. a normalized 3-5 year CAGR closer to 15-18%); forecasts assume O2C stabilizes and retail/digital services drive structural growth at ~12-13% consolidated revenue CAGR.",
    "Retail and Digital Services segments sustain high-growth trajectory: Retail revenue grew from ~1.39 lakh cr to ~1.75 lakh cr (+26% YoY) and Digital Services from ~0.77 lakh cr to ~0.85 lakh cr net of GST; combined with large capex of ~1.45 lakh cr in FY2022 (vs ~0.80 lakh cr in FY2021) signaling aggressive expansion, these consumer-facing segments are assumed to compound at 20-25% annually, partially offsetting O2C mean-reversion and supporting net profit margin recovery toward 8-9% of revenues."
  ],
  "reasoning": "FY2022 consolidated revenues of \u20b97,92,756 crore (Value of Sales and Services basis) represent a 47% YoY jump from \u20b95,39,238 crore in FY2021, primarily driven by an anomalous commodity-price-led O2C surge; this single-year growth rate is not a reliable projection basis. The 3-year CAGR (anchored on pre-pandemic and recovery trends) for consolidated revenues is estimated at ~15-18%, but mean-reversion in O2C pricing moderates the forward rate to ~12-13% blended CAGR. Net profit attributable to owners was \u20b960,705 crore in FY2022 (vs \u20b949,128 crore in FY2021, EPS \u20b992.00 basic after exceptional items), with net gearing very low at 0.04x and equity of \u20b97,79,485 crore providing strong balance-sheet capacity to fund the \u20b91,45,352 crore capex already deployed. Forecasts use a 3-5 year CAGR-anchored growth rate of ~12-13% for revenues and assume net profit margins normalize from the FY2022 level of ~7.7% toward ~8.5-8.8% by FY2025 as retail and digital segments scale profitably, with EPS computed on ~676.6 crore diluted shares."
}

Step 1: Identify the 3 most critical assumptions embedded in this forecast.
Step 2: For each assumption, describe one plausible scenario where it fails.
Step 3: Rate each assumption failure as Low / Medium / High risk to the forecast accuracy.
Step 4: Assign an overall confidence score from 0-100 (100 = completely certain).

Return ONLY valid JSON:
{
  "company": "<COMPANY>",
  "base_year": <YYYY>,
  "strategy": "<baseline|alt_strategy>",
  "assumptions": [
    {"assumption": "<text>", "failure_scenario": "<text>", "risk": "<Low|Medium|High>"}
  ],
  "confidence_score": <0-100>,
  "overall_critique": "<2 sentences>"
}
